tools.name: request_compaction
tools.description: Request compaction of this conversation when the current turn ends. Before calling, bring durable records (tickets, notes, agenda) up to date with anything still needed that only this context holds. `continuation` is optional: pass it only when work must resume by itself after compaction, as one line naming what to do next (for example "continue Phase 2 implementation"); it is sent as your next prompt after compaction. Omit it when the next turn will come from the human or from a background agent's notification. Main session only.

tools.name: request_mcp_reconnect
tools.description: Reconnect the ws MCP server when the current turn ends. Use it when that server's tools have left your tool list or a call reports the server not connected. `continuation` is optional: pass it only when work must resume by itself after the reconnect attempt, as one line naming what to do next; it is sent as your next prompt with the outcome. Omit it when the next turn will come from the human or from a background agent's notification; a failed reconnect is still reported to you. Main session only.

tools.name: mailbox_watch
tools.description: Bind ws cross-session mailbox push to this session: pass your own session_key. While bound, arriving mail starts a new turn even when the session is idle, so no background mailbox wait is needed. The same key again is a no-op; a different key rebinds. Main session only.
